name: Vox AC30/6 Top Boost (JMI, 1964)
description: JMI Vox AC30/6 with the factory Top Boost unit, as drawn on JMI OS/065 issue 4 (11 Sept 1964, AC30/6 'Normal' amplifier) plus OS/010 issue 2 (June 1963, 'Optional Brilliance Unit and connections to AC30/6'): Brilliant input 1 (68 kOhm stoppers, 1 MOhm on the idle jack), V1 ECC83 with the Brilliant and the idle Normal triodes on a shared 1.5 kOhm / 25 uF cathode and 220 kOhm plates, the 500 pF Brilliant coupling cap into the 500 kOhm log Brilliant volume (100 pF wiper to ground), the Top Boost ECC83 (100 kOhm / 1.5 kOhm / 25 uF gain stage direct-coupled to a 56 kOhm cathode follower) driving the Vox treble/bass stack (50 pF, 1 MOhm log treble, 100 kOhm, 2 x 0.022 uF, 1 MOhm log bass, 10 kOhm), the 220 kOhm channel mixer (the Normal channel's mixer resistor at volume zero), the ECC83 long-tail-pair phase inverter (100 kOhm plates, 1.2 kOhm + 47 kOhm tail, 1 MOhm grid leaks, second grid to the idle Vib/Trem volume), 0.15 uF couplings and 220 kOhm grid leaks, the Cut control (250 kOhm log rheostat + 4700 pF between the two output grids), 4 x EL84 in cathode-biased push-pull (shared 50 Ohm / 250 uF cathode, 1.5 kOhm grid stoppers, 100 Ohm screen resistors), the 4 kOhm anode-to-anode output transformer, 16 Ohm tap into 2 x 8 Ohm Celestion-class speakers in series, and the GZ34 supply (280-0-280 VAC, 16 uF reservoir at the OT centre tap, 10-20 H choke to the 320 V screen node, 22 kOhm / 22 kOhm / 10 kOhm droppers to the V1, phase-inverter and Top Boost nodes). No global negative feedback. The Vib/Trem channel (V7, V8, V9) is omitted: its volume is taken as zero.

io.note: outputVoltsPerFS calibrated (2026-11-09) to the mean RMS match gain (-18.5 dB) of the circuit_ab settings against the legacy model, so the A/B sits at the legacy loudness on average across clean and driven settings; final level is a listening-review decision

lte.note: Substeps start on backward Euler (docs §10.63), with the base at 384 kHz (minRate 352800) and VPA's events at 32 (4 substeps, 1.536 MHz). 3130 Hz gate tone (own-mains mask) -67.1 / -57.1 / -53.5 -> -79.3 / -70.9 / -61.4 dB at 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 FS; 2900 Hz -66.7 / -63.9 / -57.1 -> -67.0 / -64.6 / -59.7. At 1.0 FS the folds of the 768 kHz grid stay above -63 dB at every tone (2800-3300 Hz: -58.3 to -64.8, shipped -49 to -57); the BDF2 start reads -47.9 there. Engine T/8 truth, audio band, lead / rock DI: 0.063 / 0.141 -> 0.019 / 0.053 % (ngspice T/16 spk 0.083 -> 0.058 %); the SPICE gate at a fixed 176.4 kHz moves ac30_dimed spk 0.171 -> 0.709 %. 9900X real / driven: 29.5 / 41.5 -> 55.0 / 66.4 % of a core.

controls.label: Brilliant Volume
controls.note: VR2, 500 kOhm log, before the Top Boost valve (OS/010). The catalogue's 'B Volume' (Br); until 2026-11-11 this was bound to 'N Volume' (Vol), so rigs that turned the Normal channel off went silent

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: VR7, 1 MOhm log; wiper is the stack output; clockwise = toward the 50 pF end

controls.label: Bass
controls.note: VR8, 1 MOhm log; ends on the treble-pot bottom and ground, wiper on the 10 kOhm / 0.022 uF node; clockwise = more resistance above the wiper = more bass

controls.label: Cut
controls.note: VR3, 250 kOhm log rheostat in series with 4700 pF between the two EL84 grid circuits. Mapped so 0 = least cut (full 250 kOhm in series) and 1 = most cut (wiper at the shorted end, 4700 pF straight across the grids): more Cut = less treble, as on the panel

controls.label: Normal Volume
controls.note: The catalogue's 'N Volume': the Normal channel (V1's idle triode) is not modelled, its mixer resistor is taken at volume zero, so the guitar plays through the Brilliant channel. As on the real amp the channels mix through resistors, so this volume does not load the Brilliant one. Imported racks that used only the Normal channel are moved to Brilliant at import (see docs/CIRCUIT_ENGINE.md 10.26). Stored for presets only

controls.label: Tremolo Speed
controls.note: The Vib/Trem channel (V7 preamp, V8 ECC82 modulator, V9 oscillator) is not modelled in v1; stored for presets

controls.label: Tremolo Depth
controls.note: Vib/Trem channel not modelled; stored for presets

controls.label: Power
controls.note: no circuit meaning; mains fixed at 50 Hz (UK)

controls.label: Variac
controls.note: stored for presets; mains amplitude is fixed in v1

controls.label: Sag
controls.note: sag emerges from the GZ34 supply and the shared cathode resistor

controls.label: Bias
controls.note: cathode bias (50 Ohm / 250 uF) is set by the circuit; no adjustment on the real amp

controls.label: G5M
controls.note: legacy preset parameter with no counterpart on the AC30/6 TB front panel or in the OS/065 / OS/010 circuit; stored so presets round-trip, no circuit meaning

controls.label: Stereo
controls.note: Catalogue stereo parameter; the circuit is mono, stored only

parts.label: 2 x 12-inch Celestion T530 class (8 Ohm each), in series
parts.note: two 8 Ohm speakers in series = 16 Ohm (voxac30.org.uk); the library British 8 Ohm block (G12M class) stands in for the alnico Blue. Solved as one block with "series": 2 (every R and L doubled, C halved): the same current flows through both identical drivers, so this is the same circuit exactly, with 4 fewer states in the 16x power group (2026-11-12; DI null against the two separate blocks -183 dB)
